members.description: Establish and maintain an accurate, detailed, and up-to-date inventory of all enterprise assets with the potential to store or process data, to include: end-user devices (including portable and mobile), network devices, non-computing/Internet of Things (IoT) devices, and servers.
Cybersecurity requirements for managing information and technology assets of the entity shall be identified, documented, and approved.
Cybersecurity requirements for managing information and technology assets of the entity shall be implemented.
The policy of acceptable use of information and technology assets of the entity shall be identified, documented, approved, and communicated.
The policy of acceptable use of information and technology assets of the entity shall be implemented.
Information and technology assets of the entity shall be classified, labeled, and handled as per the relevant legislative and regulatory requirements.
Cybersecurity requirements for managing information and technology assets of the entity shall be periodically reviewed.
Developing and maintaining an accurate and up-to-date inventory of all information assets, including hardware, software, and data.

canonical.definition_short_en: This requirement establishes and maintains an accurate, current inventory of all enterprise information and technology assets that store, process, or transmit organizational data.
canonical.definition_full_en: This artifact requires the organization to build and continuously maintain a complete inventory of information and technology assets (end-user devices, servers, network devices, and IoT), including ownership and location, so that assets can be secured, monitored, and governed. It applies across all in-scope environments. The minimum expected outcome is a reviewed, up-to-date asset register. Verification is via the register itself and periodic reconciliation.
canonical.objective_en: Ensure every in-scope asset is known so it can be protected and governed.
canonical.classification_rationale: Multiple sources (CIS 1.1, NCA/ECC 2-1-1) express the same asset-inventory requirement; unified as one SecureGuide ART-REQ in SD-02.01 with source mappings.
